chapter: Earl King, later career and gear
title: Teaching Allen Toussaint What's New
summary: Toussaint credits him with teaching the song.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You mentioned Alan Toussaint and there was a song that you said you'd sing.
Yeah. Tell me that story about it.

Yeah, well he, whenever I see him, you know if he's around the piano he'll play what's new. And he'd tell me, he'd say, man, you remember you taught me how to play this song? He'd say I still play the same way you taught it to me. You know? What's new? Bob Crosby, remember him? Uh huh.

Well his bass player wrote that song. I forget his name. The guy used to play bass with him. What's new? It's a standard tune, you know? Yeah. But one time when he saw us come around and do drop, I showed him the charges.
